subfamily: Kalimotxo (red wine and cola, equal parts), over ice frozen from the same mix
glass: tall glass (about 400 ml), filled with the frozen Kalimotxo cubes
_status: v1 (Tomas, round 4). The Kalimotxo as Oxford prints it (equal parts, tall glass of ice, stir; CALIMOTXO pdf 386), with one change ruled by Wren in round 3: the ice is the same equal parts, frozen in a tray. kalimotxo_ice (about 8 cubes, ~150 ml) is counted fully melted: it has the drink's own composition, so the numbers at the last sip equal the numbers at the first. Highball strength floor (10%) is OUT by design: see Checks.
